promotionQualification: At least two current requested-book positive confirmations, then strongest median displayed fee-net dollars; horizon breaks ties. No deep review performed.
statisticalLimits: Descriptive counts and observed movements only; correlated route/time samples, modeled displayed depth and no real fills. No probability estimate or empirical cushion fitted.
feeModelLimits: Kalshi cent-precision whole-contract fragmentation bound excludes unknown account/fractional behavior. PM cumulative-order estimate is not collected commission. No actual commission validation.
cushionAssessment: A future empirical cushion would need a supported distribution of arrival movement, failed-leg recovery losses and fee-model error. FOK ceilings block adverse repricing but may leave one filled leg. Zero observed failures cannot establish zero risk; conditional settlement loss and lockup are separate.
